title: Alternatives to Airflow: Dagster, Prefect, Cloud

scenes.line1: Is Airflow always the best pick?
scenes.say: Is Apache Airflow always your best choice? Let’s see what else is out there for orchestration.

scenes.label: Dagster
scenes.sub: Strong data lineage and observability features.
scenes.say: Dagster offers modern workflow orchestration with built-in data lineage and great observability.
Prefect is developer-friendly and Pythonic. Cloud-native tools like AWS Step Functions or Google Cloud Composer scale easily and integrate tightly with cloud services.
When picking an orchestrator, consider your team’s skills, integration needs, and how much operational overhead you can handle.

scenes.question: Is Airflow always the best for cloud?
scenes.right: No. Cloud-native tools may fit better for integration and scale.
scenes.say: Don’t fall for this: Airflow isn’t always the best for cloud. Sometimes, cloud-native options are a better fit.
